products.title: Modern Bamboo Cutting Board - Large Kitchen Chopping Board
bullets: Large size perfect for family meals
products.description: This beautiful bamboo cutting board is perfect for all your kitchen needs. Large surface area makes food prep easy.

reviews.title: Smaller than expected
reviews.text: The board looks huge in the photos but when it arrived it was much smaller than I thought. Doesn't fit all my veggies at once.

reviews.title: Color is different
reviews.text: The bamboo is much lighter in person than the dark rich color shown in the main image. Looks cheap.

reviews.title: Doesn't fit under my cabinet
reviews.text: I measured my cabinet space and this is too tall when stored upright. The product page didn't show the thickness clearly.

reviews.title: Great quality
reviews.text: Love the juice groove. Very sturdy.

reviews.title: Misleading size
reviews.text: Photos make it look like a massive board. In reality it's average sized. Returning.

reviews.title: Nice board but
reviews.text: Good quality but the listing should show a banana or phone for scale. Hard to tell actual size.

products.title: Compact Air Fryer 5.8QT Digital
products.description: Enjoy healthier fried food with this powerful air fryer. Perfect for families.

reviews.title: Too big for my counter
reviews.text: I thought this was compact but it takes up so much space. The photos don't show how deep it is.

reviews.title: Won't fit under cabinets
reviews.text: My kitchen cabinets have 15 inches of clearance. This is taller. Had to return.

reviews.title: Basket is smaller than expected
reviews.text: The 5.8QT is the outer size. Actual cooking space is much less. Not enough for a family of 4.
